jobs.description:
The KPMG Advisory practice is at the forefront of transformation, offering excellent opportunities for individuals to advance their careers and expertise with KPMG. Looking ahead, we anticipate continued evolution and success within the practice, fostering both personal and professional development, thereby creating new pathways for growth. In this ever-changing market environment, our professionals must be adaptable and thrive in a collaborative, team-driven culture. At KPMG, our people are our number one priority. With a wealth of learning and career development opportunities, a world-class training facility, and leading market tools, we help our people continue to grow both professionally and personally. If you're looking for a firm with a strong team connection where you can be your whole self, have an impact, advance your skills, deepen your experiences, and have the flexibility and access to constantly find new areas of inspiration and expand your capabilities, then consider a career in Advisory.
KPMG is currently seeking a Senior Associate to join our KPMG Strategy practice.

Responsibilities:
- Perform domestic and global post-deal HR integrations with respect to mergers, acquisitions, spin-offs, carve-outs, and other similar transactions for Fortune 1000 and middle market companies and private equity investors
- Work with KPMGs cross-functional integration and separation teams on the HR portion of integration engagements, focusing on the establishment and merging of compensation and benefits platforms
- Assist with identifying HR, compensation and benefit plan exposures in HR due diligence
- Contribute to the engagement process from start to finish, including setting scopes, budgets, staffing resources, creation and coordination of client-ready deliverables with KPMGs integration and separation teams, and assist with communication of results with clients
- Support the benchmarking and refinement of compensation programs (salary, cash incentives, and equity compensation) during transactional and/or transformational situations
- Act with integrity, professionalism, and personal responsibility to uphold KPMG's respectful and courteous work environment

Qualifications:
- Minimum three years of recent actuarial or general consulting experience in the valuation, design, administration, and implementation of employee benefit and compensation plans with a top accounting or benefits consulting firm
- Bachelor's degree from an accredited university/college
- Strong command of Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint
- Experience in project management including planning, organizing, coordinating, and managing staff, clients, and/or partners towards the successful completion of a project; be on track to attain FSA, EA, CEBS, CCP and/or CEP designations
- Highly motivated, self-starter, team player, with positive attitude, strong communication and relationship-building skills
- Willingness and ability to travel

jobs.description:
Known for being a great place to work and build a career, KPMG provides audit, tax and advisory services for organizations in today's most important industries. Our growth is driven by delivering real results for our clients. It's also enabled by our culture, which encourages individual development, embraces an inclusive environment, rewards innovative excellence and supports our communities. With qualities like those, it's no wonder we're consistently ranked among the best companies to work for by Fortune Magazine, Consulting Magazine, Seramount, Fair360 and others. If you're as passionate about your future as we are, join our team.
KPMG is currently seeking a Senior Associate, Data Strategy Enablement and Innovation to join our Digital Nexus organization.
Responsibilities:
- Contribute to the firm's AI and Data architecture by applying best practices to build scalable, secure, and reliable systems; support the implementation of the firm-wide data strategy and specialized AI systems, including Knowledge Assistants and Agentic Frameworks
- Participate in the evaluation of emerging Data and AI technologies by conducting hands-on experiments with ecosystem vendors; assist in documenting technical results and translating successful proofs-of-concept into functional capabilities
- Utilize established tests, metrics, and benchmarks to assess the quality, performance, and impact of AI systems

- Work closely with technology teams and business stakeholders to ensure AI solutions and experiments align with functional priorities; clearly communicate technical concepts and data-driven insights to team members and project leaders

- Act with integrity, professionalism, and personal responsibility to uphold KPMG's respectful and courteous work environment

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, data science, or a related field from an accredited college or university is required
- Hands-on experience developing and delivering solutions on cloud platforms, with required experience in Microsoft Azure (including Azure Databricks) and a strong preference for experience with the Google Cloud Platform (GCP) ecosystem
- Practical experience with Generative AI, including hands-on work with Large Language Models (LLMs like Google Gemini), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and the implementation of agentic frameworks
- Ability to contribute to technology projects, adhere to established architectural standards, and utilize benchmarks and metrics for evaluating AI systems
- Strong communication and teamwork skills, with a proven ability to collaborate effectively with business stakeholders and translate technical ideas into actionable tasks

jobs.title: Director, Corporate Strategy
jobs.description:
Known for being a great place to work and build a career, KPMG provides audit, tax and advisory services for organizations in today's most important industries. Our growth is driven by delivering real results for our clients. It's also enabled by our culture, which encourages individual development, embraces an inclusive environment, rewards innovative excellence and supports our communities. With qualities like those, it's no wonder we're consistently ranked among the best companies to work for by Fortune Magazine, Consulting Magazine, Seramount, Fair360 and others. If you're as passionate about your future as we are, join our team.
KPMG is currently seeking a Director, Corporate Strategy to join our Corporate Strategy organization.
Responsibilities:
- Drive first-principles thinking to set firm-level strategic priorities, partner with leadership to evaluate critical, high-impact decisions, and help shape the firm's portfolio and financial aspirations
- Continuously evaluate the external market landscape, client demand shifts, macroeconomic trends, and competitor moves to define the firm's growth agenda; lead development of data-driven business cases for major strategic decisions and investments and drive core strategic analytics to deliver critical insights that enable informed decision making
- Partner with business teams (for example, Finance & Accounting, Operations) and executive leadership to evaluate financial outlook, prioritize investments, and ensure roadmaps are achieving long-term objectives
- Collaborate cross-functionally with business unit leaders, corporate development, and ecosystems leadership to continuously evaluate ecosystem network against firm's growth strategy, capability needs, innovation opportunities, and technology stack
- Prepare high-impact strategy presentations, business cases, and investment memos for the C-suite and Board of Directors; clearly articulate complex strategic concepts and provide data-driven recommendations, leveraging executive presence and influence to socialize strategic imperatives
- Help build, mentor, and lead a high-performing team of strategy managers and analysts; act as a center of excellence for strategic thought leadership within the firm
- Act with integrity, professionalism, and personal responsibility to uphold KPMG's respectful and courteous work environment

Qualifications:
- Minimum ten years of recent progressive experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, corporate development, or a related field, with at least three years in a leadership or team management role
- Master of Business Administration (MBA) from an accredited college or university is highly preferred; minimum of a Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university in business, economics, finance, or a related field is required
- Exceptional financial modeling, investment analysis, and quantitative problem-solving skills; proven ability to synthesize complex variables into clear frameworks to inform strategic direction and evaluate the financial viability of strategic bets
- Proven track record of successfully influencing and advising senior executives, stakeholders, and cross-functional leaders on high-stakes resource and investment decisions
- Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with mastery in creating executive-level presentations, investment memos, and business narratives
- Demonstrated ability to manage multiple high-stakes projects simultaneously, prioritizing resources effectively under ambiguity in a fast-paced environment

• Own functional coordination and cutover readiness for all related master data objects (material master, BOMs, purchasing records, etc.).
• Develop and execute end-to-end test scenarios for the plan-to-produce and procure-to-receive processes.
• Manage workstream plans, risks, issues, and delivery quality across client, onshore, and offshore teams.
• Apply an AI-first, value driven mindset to identify, evaluate, and responsibly apply AI-enabled solutions that can enhance client outcomes, business performance, and operational effectiveness. Leverage foundational AI concepts while upholding KPMG Trusted AI principles to drive ethical, secure, and compliant adoption across business processes and solutions.
• Act with integrity, professionalism, and personal responsibility to uphold KPMG's values and foster a respectful, courteous, and ethical work environment.

• A minimum of one full lifecycle SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud implementation is mandatory.
• Minimum seven years of SAP Supply Chain experience with strong, hands-on expertise in Production Planning and Materials Management.
• Proven and demonstrable experience leading fit-to-standard workshops and guiding clients through solution design in a public cloud context.
• Strong, in-depth knowledge of both direct procurement (for production materials) and indirect procurement (for services and non-production goods) within SAP MM.
• Deep understanding of MRP, bills of material, routings, work centers, production orders, confirmations, and inventory movements.
• Experience integrating PP and MM with other SAP modules (Sales, Finance, etc.) and managing master data conversion and cutover planning.
• Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university required.
• Ability to travel as needed to support client workshops, testing, deployment, and other program activities.
• Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future. KPMG LLP will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work visa status for this opportunity, including H-1B, L-1, TN, O-1, E-3, H-1B1, F-1, J-1, OPT, CPT, or any other employment-based visa.
